title: ecosystem
description: The unit of ecology: a community of organisms together with their abiotic environment, bound by energy flow (trophic webs from producers through consumers to decomposers) and nutrient cycling (carbon, nitrogen). Generated by ecology systematizing.

energy-flow.description: one-way flow of energy through trophic levels, light → producers → consumers → decomposers

nutrient-cycling.description: cyclic flow of matter (nitrogen, carbon) among biotic and abiotic pools
